docs(listing): the listing skill follows the listing guide in the apps repo

## Intent

Everything about listing an app belongs in the apps repo. Its listing guide now lives at apps/enter/llms.txt, and apps/llms.txt is only a short overview. The listing skill must point to the new guide, or its step-by-step link runs into nothing.

## Key changes

- The listing skill sends the assistant to https://lernapps.net/apps/enter/llms.txt for the steps.
- How to read the results comment is no longer repeated in the skill; it names the guide and keeps only what happens after "bestanden".
- The tooling's llms.txt and the risk "Creators without a shell" link the new guide; the guidance test expects the new address.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs the listing guide of the apps repo (apps#55), which must not be merged before this change.
